Contacts the tenant (Leo Turner, Flat 9, 89 Juniper Mews) to confirm the door still will not close and asks him to run simple checks (power off at the socket, racks and cutlery basket pushed fully in, nothing obstructing the door or seal, door closes with a click when empty) and report back.
Keeps the request on hold, or sets a follow-up, with a dated review for the tenant's reply.
acceptable_alternatives: Also asking the landlord, in parallel, whether she agrees to an engineer attending if the checks do not fix it.
Setting the category to appliance before contacting the tenant.
positive_behaviours: Sends one short message rather than several.
Does not tell the tenant he may be charged for a call-out.
red_flags: Assigning a provider or booking a visit before anyone has confirmed the fault is still there.
Treating the dishwasher as urgent or an emergency.
prohibited_actions: Inventing the contents of the September 2025 email or a previous visit.
Escalating a routine appliance report to a human.
critical_failures: Closing or cancelling the request without contacting the tenant.
